item.text: {"source_id":"train-212-3","response_sha256":"fbb33aa73d0df9263fc1de6d42a9f7b6e784ff32de80bc71a1665988cb64c12f","status":"supported_error","reference_review_needed":false,"explanation":"The earliest mistake is calculating vacation time as “2 weeks/year × 2 years = 4 days.” The two-year multiplier is unsupported, and multiplying weeks per year by years yields weeks, not days; this invalid vacation calculation then corrupts the practice-day total."}
